???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What is it called when the compiler rewrites the checked syntax tree as a list of small, ordered steps?"

        Lowering. It moves the program toward a more machine-like form, such as an IR.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md). Specification: [12. Glossary](../specification/glossary.md).

    ??? question "What do we call the form of the program inside the compiler that is no longer source text but not yet machine code?"

        The intermediate representation (IR). It sits between the front end and the back end.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "Which tree keeps only the meaningful parts of a program and drops punctuation whose job the tree's shape already shows?"

        The abstract syntax tree (AST), which the guide simply calls the syntax tree.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 3. The parser and the syntax tree](../compiler/guide/stage-3-parser-and-tree.md). Specification: [12. Glossary](../specification/glossary.md).
